api_spend.notes: Recurring ~$15 OpenAI auto-recharges track burn rate. Style-card poller is typically ~$0.30–0.40 every 10 minutes (~$2/hour) when running continuously.

notes.api_generation_request_count: Customer completed tasks with GPT usage (+ headroom rescue) plus style-card recreate image.png count.
notes.successful_acut_count: Completed final_candidate tasks with a non-empty result_path.
notes.actual_ai_cost: OpenAI organization costs when OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY is set; else style-card metered USD + customer API calls × unit estimate.
notes.store_net_revenue: Gross PRODUCTION payments after store fee (15%; CORP_STORE_FEE_RATE).

generation_categories.notes: style_card_recreate = Threads poller image.png count (USD from tick result.json). Customer categories from completed task params + session role. purpose_buckets classify look chips (id/profile/dating/creative).

notes.daily: Last 30 calendar days. Live API refreshes on each load; snapshot metrics.json is a daily fallback.
notes.downloads_ios: App Store Connect Analytics (App Downloads Standard) when instances are ready; else override file; else unattributed app installs.
notes.downloads_android: Set monthly.android.downloads in corp_platform_metrics.json (Play Console export) until Play Reporting API is wired.
notes.revenue: RevenueCat PRODUCTION payments by store (APP_STORE/PLAY_STORE). Legacy rows without store: UUID→iOS, GPA.*→Android. RC `price` is USD; small amounts mislabeled as KRW/JPY are treated as USD (not ÷1350), which previously showed purchases>0 with $0 revenue.
notes.funnel: Bars = distinct real users active in the window. Primary rates (volume_rates) match those bar counts. cohort_rates remain for signup-cohort nested conversion.
notes.retention: Classic calendar D1/D7/D30: cohort = users.created_at; activity = sessions, funnel events, or completed gens.
notes.ad_revenue: AdMob Network report ESTIMATED_EARNINGS by PLATFORM (source=admob_network:refresh_token). Set ADMOB_PUBLISHER_ID + ADMOB_REFRESH_TOKEN (+ ADMOB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or ADMOB_OAUTH_TOKEN; scope admob.readonly|admob.report. Override: monthly.{ios|android}.ad_revenue_usd.
notes.openai_cost: Estimated = customer API calls × $0.12 + Threads style-card poller metered USD from recreate ticks (set OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY for billed org costs).
notes.api_spend: Cause split: Threads style-card poller (result.json usd) vs customer API calls (estimate) vs other (only when OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY billed totals are available).
notes.profitability: Separate meters: api_generation_request_count, successful_acut_count, actual_ai_cost, store_net_revenue.
notes.generation_categories: Per-category image generation counts: style_card_recreate, a_cut, single_axis_edit, mood_sample, customer_other, plus purpose_buckets (id/profile/dating/creative).
